name: T01

theorem T01 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeTr N M = m.trJ * M - (m.Du + m.Dv) * N := by
  intro m N M
  unfold Scope.Model.modeTr Scope.Model.trJ
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeTr N M = m.trJ * M - (m.Du + m.Dv) * N

author: private-a1
name: T03
source:
theorem T03 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeTr N M < 0 := by
  intro m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
  rw [T01]
  have a : m.trJ * M < 0 := Int.mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos h1 h4
  have b : 0 ≤ (m.Du + m.Dv) * N := Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) h5
  omega
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeTr N M < 0

author: private-a1
name: T06
source:
theorem T06 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.Du * m.Dv * N < m.S * M := by
  intro m N M hd hM hN hP h
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hc
  have hle : m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N := Int.not_lt.mp hc
  have h1 : m.S * M * N ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N * N := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hle hN
  have hid : m.modeDet N M = M * M * m.detJ - N * M * m.S + N * N * (m.Du * m.Dv) := by
    unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.detJ Scope.Model.S
    grind
  have h2 : 0 < M * M * m.detJ := Int.mul_pos (Int.mul_pos hM hM) hd
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.Du * m.Dv * N < m.S * M

author: private-a1
name: T08
source:
theorem T08 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.Du * m.Dv → m.S ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ → 0 ≤ m.modeDet N M := by
  intro m N M hP hD
  have key : 4*(m.Du*m.Dv) * m.modeDet N M = (2*(m.Du*m.Dv)*N - m.S*M)^2 + (4*(m.Du*m.Dv)*m.detJ - m.S^2)*M^2 := by
    unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.S Scope.Model.detJ
    grind
  have hM : 0 ≤ M^2 := Int.sq_nonneg M
  have h0 : 0 ≤ 4*(m.Du*m.Dv)*m.detJ - m.S^2 := by omega
  have h1 : 0 ≤ (2*(m.Du*m.Dv)*N - m.S*M)^2 + (4*(m.Du*m.Dv)*m.detJ - m.S^2)*M^2 :=
    Int.add_nonneg (Int.sq_nonneg _) (Int.mul_nonneg h0 hM)
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro h
  have h2 : 0 < 4*(m.Du*m.Dv) * (-(m.modeDet N M)) := Int.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.Du * m.Dv → m.S ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ → 0 ≤ m.modeDet N M

name: H02

theorem H02 : ∀ (r B C : Int), Scope.Favoured r B C ↔ C < r * B := by
  intro r B C
  unfold Scope.Favoured Scope.hamGain
  omega
statement: ∀ (r B C : Int), Scope.Favoured r B C ↔ C < r * B

author: private-a1
name: H04
source:
theorem H04 : ∀ (r B C₁ C₂ : Int), C₁ ≤ C₂ → Scope.Favoured r B C₂ → Scope.Favoured r B C₁ := by
  intro r B C₁ C₂ h hf
  have h2 := (H02 r B C₂).mp hf
  exact (H02 r B C₁).mpr (by omega)
statement: ∀ (r B C₁ C₂ : Int), C₁ ≤ C₂ → Scope.Favoured r B C₂ → Scope.Favoured r B C₁

name: T10
source:
theorem T10 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.detJ * M < m.S * N := by
  intro m N M hM hN hD hneg
  have h : m.modeDet N M = M*M*m.detJ - M*N*m.S + N*N*(m.Du*m.Dv) := by
    unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.detJ Scope.Model.S
    grind
  have h2 : 0 ≤ N*N*(m.Du*m.Dv) := Int.mul_nonneg (Int.mul_nonneg hN hN) hD
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hc
  have hc' : m.S * N ≤ m.detJ * M := by omega
  have h3 := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc' (Int.le_of_lt hM)
  have e1 : M * (m.S * N) = M*N*m.S := by grind
  have e2 : M * (m.detJ * M) = M*M*m.detJ := by grind
  omega
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.detJ * M < m.S * N
